blocking_findings.detail: The frozen v0.2 preregistration lists segmentation candidate IDs and temporal statuses but does not bind an exact SRFDSegmentationBenchmarkSpec/boundary-pack identity for RUN_CHANGE_SEGMENTATION, DIRECTIONAL_CHANGE, PELT_REFERENCE or NULL_BOUNDARY_CONTROL. Repository search found no versioned segmentation boundary-pack instance outside the generic fixture-only method registry.

The frozen preregistration and segmentation registry do not declare exact source namespaces/fields. The implementation requires state_field for run-change, value_field for directional change, and an ordered numeric signal for PELT; selecting those fields during WP10 would invent scientific execution semantics after preregistration freeze.

The frozen configuration bounds contain exact family parameter ladders but no segmentation parameter ladders. DIRECTIONAL_CHANGE requires a threshold surface; PELT requires a penalty surface and the governing design requires cost/penalty/min-length surface identity. No such exact values or pack hashes are frozen.

The governing plan requires WP9 to freeze the exact candidate grid and thresholds/rules, and G-JUNE-AUTH requires exact candidate sets. WP10 may execute only the exact frozen run. Omitting these declared segmentation candidates, inventing parameters now, or substituting fixture values would be an undeclared deviation.

governing_plan_requirements: WP9 freezes exact candidate grid and thresholds/rules before June result exposure.
Segmentation identity requires temporal class, boundary pack, source fields, delay and causal admissibility.
G-JUNE-AUTH binds exact representation, segmentation, distance, family and configuration candidate sets.
WP10 runs only the exact frozen run and G10 cannot PASS on undeclared deviation.
evidence.repo_search_observation: No dedicated frozen segmentation parameter/boundary-pack registry was present in registries/research/srfd; segmentation_methods.yaml is the only segmentation registry and contains method id, temporal_mode and status only.

steps: Preserve v0.2 preregistration, its freeze decision, June authorization and this unused authority token as immutable historical evidence.
Authorize a bounded pre-run preregistration-remediation packet that uses design criteria plus synthetic/null fixtures only and does not inspect June scientific outputs.
Materialise versioned SRFDSegmentationBenchmarkSpec/boundary packs with exact source fields, chronology/delay rules and complete directional-change/PELT parameter surfaces.

Present the new preregistration for operator freeze, then present a new exact June execution-authority decision because the existing AUTHORIZE_JUNE binds only the v0.2 manifest hash.
Only after those approvals may WP10 restart from a clean bounded branch and consume the one newly authorized run.

rollback: No benchmark run has started. Preserve main and all frozen/authorized v0.2 evidence; close or retain this blocked WP10 branch/PR. Do not consume the existing token, edit frozen preregistration, fetch provider data, read Validation, force-push, or execute a partial benchmark.
